assessment: In this study, Hahn et al., taught crows to perform a multi-item working memory task designed to mimic traditional monkey tasks. Using a combination of behavior and electrophysiology, the authors convincingly show that the neural mechanisms that limit working memory capacity in primates also limit working memory capacity in crows. Such cross-species comparisons are fundamental to understanding the computational constraints that are placed on cognition and the brain.
